svg.title: K-SACCR | How SA-CCR aggregates a netting set
svg.desc: Trades are assigned top-down to netting sets, asset classes and hedging sets; the effective notionals are then aggregated bottom-up into the add-ons, the PFE and the exposure value.

text.font-family: Georgia, Times New Roman, serif
